description:
### Introduction 
Transform treasury and liquidity management by integrating real-time tokenised deposit balances and internal value transfers across HSBC’s permissioned distributed ledger. TDS APIs enable corporate customers to automate workflows, increase visibility, and optimize funding, leveraging HSBC’s innovation in digital assets.
#### Key Features
* The Token Operations API enables HSBC corporate customers to create, transfer, and redeem tokenised deposits securely and in real time, directly within the bank’s distributed ledger environment.

* The Wallet Balance Enquiry API provides real-time visibility of tokenised deposit holdings across HSBC Blockchain Wallets, supporting efficient liquidity management and operational oversight.

* The Wallet Transactions Enquiry API provides automated, real-time access to detailed records of tokenised value movements within HSBC Blockchain Wallets, enhancing transparency, reconciliation, and operational control.

### Authentication and Authorization
API Authentication is performed using either ProfileID/Secret or a signed JSON Web Token (JWT). The token must be provided in the header of the HTTP request every time you
invoke HSBC's API services. This ensures only authorised and pre-approved organisations can access and utilise our API services. 
Client Can be either Basic or Bearer token. Basic token like "Basic Base64(<profile-id>:<client-secret>); While Bearer token like "JWS <JWT token>"
Please refer to the Security section.
### Response and Error Codes
The API uses common HTTP status codes in the response header to indicate success or failure. Specific error code and description will be returned in the custom error schema.
